split_policy: 15 development and 15 holdout cases per family × size bin, assigned before costs
cost_policy: nonnegative integers, at most 1,000,000; no optimum labels
unbalanced_policy: 15% per split, zero-cost dummy row/column required by the solver
zero_margin_policy: 5% per split; zeroed marginal quantities are redistributed before optional imbalance
